definitions: To make a strong, positive, or lasting effect on the mind or feelings of (someone).
To make an indentation or mark on (a surface) by pressing something into it.
To apply a stamp or mark to (something) with pressure.
To force (someone) into service, especially into a navy.
examples: His speech really impressed the audience.
The seal impressed a clear image into the wax.
The company logo was impressed onto the stationery.
Sailors were impressed into the Royal Navy.
pastTenses: impressed (past simple), impressed (present perfect), impressed (past perfect)
